QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Leave Me Alone
QuestInfo.0: It was revealed that Violetta is the daughter of the Prime Minister. She was so shocked that she fled from the Banquet Hall. Then the Prime Minister revealed his terminal illness. Man, waaaaay too much drama going on with these 'shrooms. Talk to the Prime Minister.
QuestInfo.1: The Prime Minister refused to be treated, spouting nonsense excuses. Bring Violetta from the Rose Garden to convince him to get treatment.
QuestInfo.2: Violetta disappeared because she could not accept her family secrets. The Prime Minister refused to get treatment. Despite all the insanity, you were able to convince Violetta to help.

0.msg: #face1#Violetta... I cannot believe she was my daughter. If I had known, I... I would have... *Cough cough* It no longer matters. The doctor has spoken... I am #rterminally ill#k... My just reward for my wicked ways...

1.msg: Don't say that! You've finally found your daughter. You have so much to live for! First we need you to get some treatment and-

2.msg: #face1#No, sire. I deserve this. I have neglected so many lives already. How can I turn on #bmy own diseased flesh#k after what I have done?

3.msg: That doesn't even make a lick of sense! #h0#, fetch the princess. She can convince him to receive treatment!

0.msg: Violetta will probably be in #rVioletta's Garden#k. She would always go there whenever she was having a hard day. Tell her about the Prime Minister and bring her here at once! Please!
This mushroom is about to die, and you refuse?! You MONSTER!

1.0: Please, just leave me alone. I need time to take it all in. How can I... How can I possibly accept this shocking truth so fast?
1.1: W-what? The Prime Minister-I mean, my dad... is ill? Why have you neglected to tell me? And refusing treatment?! Why would he be so foolish? Let's go back at once. I must convince him before it's too late.

0.msg: Bring the princess back from #rVioletta's Garden#k. Tell her to persuade the Prime Minister.
